_comment: Plugin manager. Left: every plugin as a sortable, searchable table (chitable gives search/sort/column-picking/export for free, which is why there is no hand-rolled filter box). Right: what the selected plugin is, and the dependency edges in both directions.
title: Plugins

sections.title: Installed plugins
sections.description: Every plugin ChiSurf discovered. Sort by any column, search with the box above the table, and use the column picker to show ids, versions or dependency columns.
One row per plugin. 'Requires' is what must load first; 'Required by' is what breaks if you switch it off.

columns.title: Status
columns.tooltip: enabled, disabled, library, cli only, or a maturity flag.

columns.title: Requires
columns.tooltip: Loaded before this plugin — a module-level import.

columns.title: Required by
columns.tooltip: These stop working if this plugin is switched off.

columns.title: Optional
columns.tooltip: Reached only after startup, from a button press or a guarded import.

sections.label: Show disabled plugins
sections.description: Include switched-off plugins in the table. Off, they are hidden entirely.
How many plugins were found, how many are off, and whether anything is unsaved.
What the selected plugin is, where it lives, and how it is wired to the others.

sections.label: Disabled
sections.description: Switch this plugin off. If other plugins require it, you are told which before the change sticks.

sections.label: Show in main toolbar
sections.description: Pin this plugin to the main window toolbar.

sections.label: Remember window state
sections.description: Whether this one plugin's window reopens where you left it. 'Plugin default' defers to its manifest and the global setting below.

sections.label: Window state (all plugins)
sections.description: Whether plugin windows remember their size and position. 'Plugin default' lets each manifest decide.

sections.title: Dependencies
sections.description: Every dependency edge touching this plugin, in both directions, with the state of the plugin at the other end.
